scope: Single-step global model verification, frozen PP calibration, and one two-action Jinan diagnostic.

model.interpretation: The full-frame stochastic extension is tested where the conditional reference randomizes every actor.

action_diagnostic.anchor: First ten-second epoch from 600 to 660 inclusive with at least two feasible states.
action_diagnostic.arms: PhasePressure and the first feasible non-PhasePressure state in executor order, then own-state PhasePressure from the next decision.
action_diagnostic.cost: Post-step halted vehicles summed across the fixed 144 controlled lanes and 450 seconds.
action_diagnostic.decision: Structurally valid calibration permits the paired diagnostic. Numerical calibration failure is retained and limits the action result to a failure diagnostic.

storage: jtl110gpu2. Keep vehicle records, coefficients, caches and per-draw sequences server-side. Retrieve compact receipts.
